semantic_fragments.content: Data analysis acceptance criteria for simulated tasks: Success - The participant completed the step independently, regardless of the amount of time it took. Allowance was made for quick, minor self-corrections within the criteria of success. Close Call - Any instance of a potential failure that was avoided by the participant's vigilance, as indicated by observation of the participant almost failing to complete or incorrectly completing a step, or anecdotal participant comments. Fail - The participant did not complete, or incorrectly completed, the step.

Knowledge assessment scoring criteria: Correct - Participant gives a correct answer successfully aligning with success criteria. Incorrect - Participant gives an incorrect answer. Located Information - Participant is able to locate correct answer in labeling. Did not Locate Information - Participant is unable to locate correct answer in labeling.

Critical task results (n=30 participants):
- Task 1: User Self-Trains - User fail to perform self-trains: 0/30 (0%)
- Task 2: Power on - User can not install the batteries properly according to instruction for use: 0/30 (0%); User can not power on the device successfully: 0/30 (0%)
- Task 3: Treatment - User can not turn on the device: 0/30 (0%)
Task 5 is assessed in the knowledge assessment.

Operation knowledge assessment questions (n=30):
Q1: Is it easy or difficult to install the batteries? - Very difficult: 0(0%), Difficult: 0(0%), Normal: 2(7%), Easy: 23(77%), Very easy: 5(16%)
Q2: Is the user manual easy or difficult to read and understanding? - Very difficult: 0(0%), Difficult: 0(0%), Normal: 4(13%), Easy: 16(53%), Very easy: 10(34%)
Q3: Is the panel of the device easily to be recognized? - Very difficult: 0(0%), Difficult: 0(0%), Normal: 5(17%), Easy: 12(40%), Very easy: 13(43%)
Q4: Very difficult: 0(0%), Difficult: 0(0%), Normal: 6(20%), Easy: 13(43%), Very easy: 11(37%)
Q5: Very difficult: 0(0%), Difficult: 1(3%), Normal: 8(27%), Easy: 12(40%), Very easy: 9(30%)
Q6: Very difficult: 0(0%), Difficult: 0(0%), Normal: 8(27%), Easy: 14(47%), Very easy: 8(26%)

Maintenance knowledge assessment (n=30):
Q1: Do you think the device can be stored under -20°C? - Yes: 0(0%), No: 30(100%), No idea: 0(0%)
Q2: Do you think the device can be used over the temperature 40°C? - Yes: 0(0%), No: 30(100%), No idea: 0(0%)
Q3: Do you think the device can be used under the temperature 5°C? - Yes: 0(0%), No: 30(100%), No idea: 0(0%)
Q4: Do you think the device can be soaked or immersed to clean? - Yes: 0(0%), No: 27(90%), No idea: 3(10%)

Operation environment knowledge assessment (n=30):
Q1: Do you think the device can be used during examination in hospital? - Yes: 0(0%), No: 27(90%), No idea: 3(10%)
Q2: Do you think the device can be disturbed by cell phone or other wireless equipment? - Yes: 3(10%), No: 27(90%), No idea: 0(0%)
Q3: Do you think it can be used during cooking? Driving? Sleeping? - Yes: 0(0%), No: 26(87%), No idea: 4(13%)

Important indications understanding assessment (n=30):
Q1: If you have a mercury thermometer, could you use the Infrared Forehead Thermometer? - Yes: 0(0%), No: 30(100%), No idea: 0(0%)
Q2: If your skin broken, do you think you can still use the Infrared Forehead Thermometer? - Yes: 0(0%), No: 30(100%), No idea: 0(0%)
Q3: If anyone who can not express themselves or can not operate the device, do you think the device can be used by them? - Yes: 0(0%), No: 30(100%), No idea: 0(0%)
